ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The lower left of the figure is the organic structure that needs to be encoded, containing a central carbon skeleton, with an iodine atom I connected on the left; near the center there are three carbon-skeleton line segments representing three methyl substituents, and mechanistic curved arrows are also drawn in the figure. In the upper right there is another reagent structure with a negative sign, and it also has a curved arrow pointing to hydrogen. Reasoning: The question requires ignoring arrows, and according to the method draft isolating the actual covalent structure to be encoded, while also ignoring the separate reagent. The structure being encoded is the central carbon connected to three methyl carbons and one iodine atom, that is, tert-butyl iodide. Choose one methyl as the starting point of the main chain, write it as C-C, and add the other two methyl branches and iodine on the central carbon, obtaining SMILES: CC(C)(C)I.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First visually isolate the actual covalent structure to be encoded and ignore the mechanism arrows and the separate reagent. Count the atoms attached to the central carbon: three methyl carbons and one iodine. Choose one methyl as the SMILES main chain carbon, write the central carbon next, add the other two methyl groups as branches, and attach iodine to the central carbon, yielding CC(C)(C)I.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左下方是需要编码的有机结构，包含一个中心碳骨架，左侧连有碘原子 I；中心附近有三条碳骨架线段表示三个甲基取代基，并且图中还画有机理弯箭头。右上方另有一个带负号的试剂结构，也有弯箭头指向氢。推理：题目要求忽略箭头，并按方法草案隔离实际要编码的共价结构，同时忽略分开的试剂。被编码的结构是中心碳连接三个甲基碳和一个碘原子，即叔丁基碘。选择一个甲基作为主链起点，写作 C-C，并在中心碳上添加另外两个甲基分支和碘，得到 SMILES：CC(C)(C)I。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES route: identify the covalent skeleton in the drawn substrate and translate it, rather than using reaction-mechanism inference.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to read the bottom-left organic substrate while ignoring all curved arrows and the separate top-right anion/base. The relevant skeleton shows a central carbon bonded to iodine and to three terminal carbon groups, i.e. a tert-butyl iodide framework.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the requested output is a SMILES expression and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply skeletal-structure conventions: unlabeled line ends are carbons with implicit hydrogens, iodine is written explicitly as I, and a central carbon attached to three methyl branches and iodine can be represented in SMILES as a tert-butyl group bearing I.
